entities.name: Voyager 1
entities.look: Golden record mounted on side, long boom antenna, radio dish, multi-hundred-watt radioisotope thermoelectric generators on booms.

entities.name: a Titan rocket
entities.look: Tall white multi-stage rocket with boosters.

entities.name: Jupiter
entities.look: Large gas giant with swirling orange and white cloud bands and the Great Red Spot.

entities.name: Io
entities.look: Mottled yellow and red volcanic rocky moon surface.

entities.name: Saturn
entities.look: Gas giant planet with prominent extensive ring system.

entities.name: Titan
entities.look: Large moon covered in a thick orange hazy atmosphere.

entities.name: Earth
entities.look: Blue planet with white clouds and continents.

places.name: Cape Canaveral
places.look: Coastal launch pad area with gantry towers, concrete structures, and flat scrubland under a daytime sky.

places.name: Interstellar Space
places.look: Vast dark void with distant stars and faint scattered starlight.

moments.cue: Twenty four billion kilometres away, a 49-year-old spacecraft had gone quiet.

moments.action: Voyager 1 lifted off from Cape Canaveral.
moments.cue: Voyager 1 lifted off from Cape Canaveral on a Titan rocket.

moments.action: A strange plume rising off the edge of the moon Io.
moments.cue: spotted a strange plume rising off the edge of the moon Io.

moments.action: Voyager 1 swung past its rings and Titan.
moments.cue: Voyager 1 swung past its rings and its giant moon, Titan.

moments.action: Earth was a speck caught in a ray of sunlight.
moments.cue: Earth was a speck smaller than a single pixel, caught in a ray of scattered sunlight.

moments.action: It crossed the edge into interstellar space.
Its signal came back from a light-day away.
moments.cue: its signal came back. Alone, almost a light-day from home, it had looked after itself.
